messages:
Erin Liu: Customer reports intermittent 500s and a big latency tail when calling hosted gpt-open-7b. Happened around 2026-03-15T14:23:12Z. Example request id: 01b4c9f2. They can reproduce ~3/10 calls failing. Can we assemble minimal cross-SDK repros and debug bundle steps to send them?

Sam Patel: Got it. Can you paste the full request-id and the region? Also want the client-side timeout and SDK version if available.

Erin Liu: Request id 01b4c9f2 (us-west1). SDK reported: redwood-python 0.9.1, client timeout set to 10s. Server-side logs show a backend timeout then a 502->500 cascade. Snippet from logs:
```
[2026-03-15T14:23:12Z] req=01b4c9f2 route=/v1/chat model=gpt-open-7b latency=11234ms backend_err="model_timeout" status=500
[2026-03-15T14:23:12Z] req=01b4c9f2 trace=trace_8f3a size=1.2MB
```

Meera Gonzalez: I'll draft three tiny repros (curl, py, js) that match their call pattern. Also request they run the CLI debug gather and upload. Here's a compact curl they can paste: 
```bash
curl -v https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \n  -H "X-Request-ID: 01b4c9f2" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model": "gpt-open-7b", "input": "Summarize the following...", "max_tokens": 60}'
```

Meera Gonzalez: Python snippet (requests fallback if SDK not available):
```python
# pip install redwood
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="$REDWOOD_KEY", region="us-west1", timeout=10)
resp = client.chat.create(model="gpt-open-7b", input="Summarize...", max_tokens=60, headers={"X-Request-ID": "01b4c9f2"})
print(resp.text)
```

Meera Gonzalez: Node/JS minimal using fetch: 
```js
// node >=18 or use fetch polyfill
const res = await fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${process.env.REDWOOD_KEY}`, 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-Request-ID': '01b4c9f2' },
  body: JSON.stringify({ model: 'gpt-open-7b', input: 'Summarize...', max_tokens: 60 }),
});
console.log(await res.text());
```

Meera Gonzalez: Go minimal (net/http): 
```go
reqBody := `{"model":"gpt-open-7b","input":"Summarize...","max_tokens":60}`
req, _ := http.NewRequest("POST", "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat", strings.NewReader(reqBody))
req.Header.Set("Authorization","Bearer "+os.Getenv("REDWOOD_KEY"))
req.Header.Set("Content-Type","application/json")
req.Header.Set("X-Request-ID","01b4c9f2")
client := &http.Client{Timeout: 10 * time.Second}
resp, _ := client.Do(req)
body, _ := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
fmt.Println(string(body))
```

Sam Patel: Nice. Also ask them to capture a debug bundle with these steps so we can correlate server traces:
1) Run the reproduction that fails once or twice.
2) Run redwoodctl diag collect --request-id=01b4c9f2 --include-model-logs --include-kvcache --output=diag-01b4c9f2.tar.gz
3) Upload to the support portal link we provide or paste the pre-signed upload if they're blocked by corp network.

Erin Liu: For customers behind corp proxies: suggest running the curl with `-v` and saving the tcpdump: `sudo tcpdump -w /tmp/01b4c9f2.pcap host api.redwood.ai and port 443` then attach.

infra-bot: Collected trace trace_8f3a for req=01b4c9f2, size=1.2MB, node=gpu-12b-2, kernels=qkv-opt-1.2

Alex R: Also check billing/quota for this org — transient rate limit fallback sometimes returns 5xx. Erin, can you confirm org id and billing status while they reproduce?

Erin Liu: Org is org_72b. I asked the customer to run the snippets and CLI collect. Sent upload instructions with a presigned link. I'll paste debug bundle here when they upload. Opening a ticket in Zendesk for triage and will attach the bundle and these snippets.

support-bot: Ticket created: SUP-45321. Assigning to support-tier-2.

Erin Liu: Thanks all — will follow up when bundle lands.
